Restrict risky activity (email) on jump server: runtime control
Risk assessment for remote access: documented artifact
Firewall dedication cannot be determined from plan
Network device admin access: AWS-managed control plane
Architectural scoping decision for middleware/back-office
Logging on jump server: covered by Control 6.4
Credential storage analysis: process/architectural review
Mutual TLS: not exposed in Terraform plan for ALBs
Swift application-layer flows (RMA, GUI, interfaces)
Swift KB article 5021566 dynamic cipher guidance
Secure coding guidelines for credential protection
Runtime TLS verification: not in terraform plan
Password policy reviewed annually
Conditional password relaxation when MFA in use
IAM lockout threshold/duration: not configurable in Terraform
NoLMHash registry setting: OS runtime config
Password storage location within secure zone
PIN settings for tokens/mobile devices/HSMs
LAU key configuration: Swift application credentials
Annual account review: periodic review activity
Prompt privilege revocation: HR/process control
Break-glass procedure documentation and logging
Vendor role separation guidance (Alliance Access)
Transaction submission/approval separation, Swift app logic
Credential sharing scope governance: not a technical control
Network/OS admin separation requires HR/identity data
Command-line history (bash_history): EC2 runtime config
Procedures for suspicious login identification
Daily review cadence: human/automated review process
Incident reporting to security team: workflow/organisational
Compliance with applicable laws and regulations
Swift application logs (Alliance Access/Gateway)
Separate credentials for log protection: IAM design detail
